name: com.getmixly/recipes
title: Mixly Recipes
description: Thermomix and everyday recipes from Mixly, with step settings. Not affiliated with Vorwerk.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search Mixly's public recipes (Thermomix first, plus air fryer, slow cooker, pressure cooker, oven and everyday cooking). Use it when someone wants recipe ideas, a dish by name, or something that fits an ingredient, a diet, a time limit, a course, a cuisine or an occasion. Returns up to 20 recipes, best first, each with its id, title, total time, diets and its page on getmixly.com. All arguments are optional: with none, it returns this week's best recipes. Diet and allergen filters are read from ingredient lists and are not a medical guarantee.

query.description: Words to look for in titles and ingredients, such as "leek soup" or "chocolate". Up to four words count; a recipe must contain all of them.

language.description: Language to answer in. Default: en.

kitchen.description: Kind of kitchen the recipe is written for. thermomix: guided Thermomix recipes; everyday: hob and basic equipment.

cuisine.description: Cuisine as a two-letter country code: "it" Italian, "fr" French, "es" Spanish, "in" Indian, "jp" Japanese, "mx" Mexican and so on.

ingredient.description: One main ingredient the recipe must use, such as "leek" or "salmon".

diets.description: Only recipes that fit all of these diets.

exclude_allergens.description: Leave out recipes with any of these allergens (EU list). On the careful side: for gluten, milk, egg, nut and peanut only recipes marked as free from them are returned.

max_total_minutes.description: Longest total time, in minutes, start to table.

thermomix_model.description: Only recipes that work on this Thermomix model.

limit.description: How many recipes to return. Default 8.

cursor.description: For the next page: the "next_cursor" of the previous answer, with the same other arguments.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Get one Mixly recipe in full: description, total and active time, servings, ingredients, numbered steps with Thermomix settings (time, temperature, speed, reverse, mode) where the recipe uses one, tips, diets, the photo and its page on getmixly.com. Use it before answering questions about a recipe or cooking from it. Nutrition values are not available.

id.description: Recipe id from search_recipes or whats_in_season (8 characters, such as "1a2b3c4d"). A recipe address on getmixly.com also works.

language.description: Language to answer in. Default: en.

tools.name: whats_in_season
tools.description: This week's seasonal selection on Mixly: the fresh ingredients in season this month (northern hemisphere) and a varied set of recipes that use what is in season. The selection changes every Monday. Use it for questions like what to cook this week or what is in season now.

language.description: Language to answer in. Default: en.

kitchen.description: Kind of kitchen the recipe is written for. thermomix: guided Thermomix recipes; everyday: hob and basic equipment.

limit.description: How many recipes to return. Default 8.

tools.name: list_catalogue
tools.description: List what Mixly's recipes can be browsed and filtered by, with how many recipes each has and its page on getmixly.com: kitchens, courses, cuisines, occasions (marked when they are on now or coming up) and ingredients in season. Use it to learn the valid filter values for search_recipes, or to answer what kinds of recipes Mixly has.

language.description: Language to answer in. Default: en.

kitchen.description: Kind of kitchen the recipe is written for. thermomix: guided Thermomix recipes; everyday: hob and basic equipment. Default: thermomix.

tools.name: show_recipe
tools.description: Show one Mixly recipe to the person as a card: photo, title, time, servings, diet badges, ingredients, steps with Thermomix settings and a button that opens the recipe on getmixly.com. Takes a recipe id returned by search_recipes or whats_in_season. Use it when the person has chosen a recipe and wants to see or cook it. Returns the same data as get_recipe, so there is no need to call both.

id.description: Recipe id from search_recipes or whats_in_season (8 characters, such as "1a2b3c4d"). A recipe address on getmixly.com also works.

language.description: Language to answer in. Default: en.

tools.name: show_recipes
tools.description: Show a short row of Mixly recipes to the person as cards with photo, title and time, each linking to its page on getmixly.com. Takes 1 to 8 recipe ids returned by search_recipes or whats_in_season, in the order to show them. Use it after choosing the recipes that best answer the request, so the person can pick one.

ids.description: Recipe ids, in the order to show them.

language.description: Language to answer in. Default: en.

title.description: A short heading for the row, in the person's language, such as "Quick vegetarian dinners".
